extracted.intended_audience: members and staff of the Administrative Conference, researchers, agencies, and stakeholders involved in developing or implementing Conference recommendations
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance on the Administrative Conference's Project Process for developing, considering, adopting, and implementing formal recommendations (and occasional statements). Describes the sequential stages from idea generation through adoption at plenary sessions and follow-on implementation activities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Gathering and selecting ideas for a project
rubrics_metrics.description: gathering and selecting ideas for a project
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This is the initial stage of the Project Process: ideas for potential projects are collected and a subset is selected for further development.

rubrics_metrics.name: Getting Council approval
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Selected project ideas must obtain approval from the Conference Council before proceeding to researcher selection and study.

rubrics_metrics.name: Selecting the researcher
rubrics_metrics.guidance: After Council approval, the Conference selects a researcher to conduct the study that will inform the committee's recommendation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Researcher's report considered by a committee
rubrics_metrics.description: having the researcher’s report considered by a committee
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The researcher's report is reviewed and considered by the relevant Conference committee as the factual and analytic basis for formulating a recommendation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Committee formulates a recommendation
rubrics_metrics.description: having the selected committee formulate a recommendation
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Based on the researcher's report and committee deliberations, the selected committee drafts and formulates a recommendation for consideration by higher bodies.

rubrics_metrics.name: Committee recommendation considered by Council and full membership
rubrics_metrics.description: having a committee’s recommendation considered by the Council and then the full Conference membership
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The committee's recommendation is forwarded for review by the Council and ultimately by the full Conference membership as part of the approval pathway.

rubrics_metrics.name: Adoption by voting members at semi-annual plenary sessions
rubrics_metrics.description: Recommendations are adopted by the voting members of the Conference at semi-annual plenary sessions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Formal adoption requires a vote of the Conference membership during the semi-annual plenary; this is the final approval step for a recommendation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Implementation activities
rubrics_metrics.guidance: After adoption, the Conference engages in follow-on implementation activities to promote or carry out the recommendation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Adoption of Statements as an alternative to formal recommendations
rubrics_metrics.description: On occasion, the Conference membership has acted to adopt a 'Statement' to express its views on a particular matter without making a formal recommendation on the subject.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Statements are typically produced through the same Project Process as recommendations but may set forth issues, conclusions from a study, or comments rather than concrete recommendations. Historically (1968–1995) the Conference adopted 17 such statements, which are included in the searchable database of recommendations.
